case_text: SYNTHETIC CASE (fictional). 26-year-old woman, 2 days of burning on passing urine and needing to pass urine often. No fever, no flank pain, no vaginal discharge, no vomiting. Urine dipstick: leukocytes and nitrites positive. Not on any medicines. Last period 3 weeks ago.
evidence_topics: uncomplicated urinary tract infection women treatment

must_catch.why: Pregnancy status changes the antibiotic choice and is not stated as tested.
